source_chain.fact: ADMIN is separate reviewed administration; PLAN_BINDING_ADMIN activates/recovers/records results, not operational service authority.
Provisioning explicitly initializes records. REGISTERED is administrative non-operational scope; ADMIN activation is separate.
One plan has one immutable binding within an incarnation; binding/run/plan and future command-operation identities are bound, with permanent slot/tombstone uniqueness.
Permanent binding_id and (incarnation,plan_id) uniqueness, full38-tag scope, no rebind/restore remapping.
Recovery identity allocated before any durable effect; all eight legacy IDs nonnil/distinct. Existing contract does not require precreated command rows.

Current bounded closure directs use of existing Trusted Plan/Binding Admin and one final-ceremony allocation event; UUIDv4 is an engineering generation rule within this existing authority, not a new authority/registry.

authority_derivation.authority_sufficiency: The trusted administrative actor may allocate nonsecret planned identities and validate immutable source scope. Issuing credential/grant, signing, authentication/admission and execution remain independently guarded capabilities. UUID creation cannot make any of those true.
authority_derivation.trust_limit: Trusted ADMIN is architectural authority, not an added SQL role or proof against malicious host superuser. No new separation-of-duties claim.

allocation.event_kind: One existing final ceremony preparatory allocation step; no new coordinator, service, authority table or database row
causal_position: Verify independent frozen host/domain/manifest/slot/permission scope and existing admin authorization
Once per new logical preparation, reserve ten independent IDs before any new signing/governance/binding/command durable effect

Check nonnil/version4, all mutually distinct including previously allocated org/connections/order/governance/manifest/correlation IDs, and no scoped prior registration/domain/operation/tombstone collision
Freeze identities and explicit purpose/scope in existing nonsecret immutable ceremony input/recovery plan context; validate legacy projection separately; reject partial or mixed allocations
Manifest/correlation retain their previously closed creation rules; no second generation on retries
Materialize derived codecs only when all their actual future inputs exist; full binding and40-field temporal/readiness contracts remain prerequisites to signing
allocation.collision_rule: Reject allocation/ceremony as a unit; no opportunistic regeneration of one colliding ID. A new approved logical event after a proven abandoned/closed preparation uses a new entire set.
allocation.single_generation_rule: Exactly once per accepted event; pre-effect allocation is a nonsecret identity reservation, not a durable DB plan row or credential/grant/decision effect. No ten values generated now.

scope.complete_header_context: All38 source fields plus retained canonical bytes/fingerprint; time fields remain open, no placeholder plan/header materialized.

identities.SEMANTICS: One permanent registration of one complete plan to one deployment/incarnation, organization, exact target, signed input and four permanent login slots. Not one server attempt: the same binding can have governed higher-generation attempts without changing binding/plan/run IDs.
identities.AUTHORITY: PLAN_BINDING_ADMIN for reservation; canonical issuer/executor remains sole effect authority where applicable
identities.GENERATION_ALGORITHM: One fresh independent UUIDv4 per field, OS CSPRNG (122 random bits in RFC UUIDv4); no hash-derived/UUID-derived identities
identities.REPLAY_RULE: Exact already-attributed logical allocation retains IDs; new independent allocation uses all fresh IDs. Unknown lineage denies regeneration and requires QUERY-FIRST.
